tasks: first 8 entries of existing fixed48 D_gate manifest; no selection by new outcomes or Q changes

arms.Q0: original vector24 union lexical8 candidate order

schedule: 5 repeat blocks; every task has 4 randomly ordered serial arm calls in each block; 4 task workers; finish each block before next
prompt: unchanged native semantic_select; only recall replaced by a function-local replay of recorded query/candidates/scores; native short integer protocol and retries
first_input: reuse historical public contract plus shared initial analysis, no new analysis or embedding
distance: Jaccard set distance; two empty valid sets have distance 0; failed calls never treated as empty
effect: between-arm mean pair distance minus half the two within-arm mean pair distances; macro average by task family
inference: 10000 paired task-family bootstrap; 19999 random repeat-block arm-label swaps within task; one-sided separation test; Holm over 3 primary comparisons
decision: complete valid 160 operations required for affirmative conclusion; positive effect with CI lower>0 and Holm p<=0.05 supports detectable order effect; otherwise inconclusive, not equivalence
Q_specific_interpretation: Q2-Q1 tests learned-Q reordering versus similarity; Q2-Q3 tests assignment of learned values versus its permutation; neither tests usefulness or Joint
retries: original selector at most 2 format responses; original transport requester retained; no extra experiment reruns
